title: In-flight beta conversion playbook and cross-functional runway
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create and execute a repeatable playbook to convert active beta and lighthouse accounts that are currently using Redwood Hosted/Dedicated trials into paying production customers or GA-ready pilots. This ticket coordinates release notes, product/engineering readiness, CS enablement, sales play, and telemetry checks. Focus is on low-friction handoffs, measurable success criteria, mitigation plans for regressions, and customer feedback loops to capture product-debt blockers before GA conversions.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence with step-by-step handoff and templates
Release notes and product impact matrix finalized and approved by Eng + Legal
Support runbook and severity matrix published and internal training completed
At least 5 in-flight lighthouse accounts have documented conversion plans (timeline + commercial ask)
Telemetry dashboard shows no >5% increase in p50/p95 latency or >2% error-rate regression on canary conversions
Survey + interview templates ready and at least 3 post-conversion interviews scheduled
Sales/CS enablement pack distributed to SDR/AE/CS teams with objection handling and pricing FAQ

2026-03-11: CS templates for customer communications created (onboarding checklist, SSO/KMS checklist). Sales provided pricing anchors for lighthouse accounts.

notes: Trade-offs discussed: aggressive conversion schedule increases revenue but raises risk of performance regressions. Decision: use staged canary (3 accounts -> 5 accounts -> remaining cohort) with hard rollback triggers. Also decided to prioritize instrumentation (detailed token-level cost traces) over cosmetic console polish for initial conversions. Follow-ups: Eng to provide instrumentation PRs, CS to finalize communication cadence, Sales to confirm contract templating.
